A shadow falls over a peaceful studio village, where a victim is found bound by a bizarre and unique method—only the thumbs and pinky fingers are tied. DNA collected at the scene begins to point toward the culprit of the 'Suyu-dong Arson Murder,' a case from two years ago that turned all evidence into ashes. ko.description:

20:11 (재방편 정보) 기타이 사유리 사건 by 디바메이

평범한 가장 제임스 에드워즈(James Edwards)가 마주한 지옥 같은 새벽. 출산을 단 3일 앞둔 아내 데브라 에반스(Debra Evans)는 배가 갈기갈기 찢겨나간 채 쓰러져 있었고, 그 안의 태아 엘리야(Elijah)는 흔적도 없이 사라졌습니다. 현장에 남겨진 10살 딸 사만다(Samantha)의 시신과 증발해 버린 8살 아들 조슈아(Joshua). 범인들은 왜 잔인하게 산모의 배를 가르고 아기를 훔쳐간 것일까요? 그리고 현장에서 살아남은 19개월 막내 조던(Jordan)만이 알고 있는 그날 밤의 진실. 증거 하나 남기지 않은 치밀한 범죄 뒤에 숨겨진 세 남녀의 추악한 욕망과, 8살 소년의 절박한 목소리가 가리킨 충격적인 배후를 추적합니다.

ko.description:

16:45 (재방편 정보) 구마가야 여성 교살사건 by 디바메이

일본 최고의 유흥가 요시와라에서 인형 같은 외모로 12만 팔로워를 거느린 에이스 쿠도 마이(工藤舞). 2023년 5월, 그녀가 일하던 밀폐된 방 안에서 참혹한 비명소리가 울려 퍼지고, 현장에서는 피투성이가 된 그녀를 15분 동안이나 말없이 지켜보던 기괴한 남성 이마이 유타카(今井裕)가 검거됩니다. 한때 그녀를 위해 수천만 원을 쏟아붓던 열성 단골이었던 그는, 왜 가명까지 써가며 다시 그녀를 찾아와 이토록 잔인한 비극을 설계한 것일까요? "사랑해서가 아니라, 그녀의 인생을 빼앗고 싶었다"는 그의 소름 끼치는 고백 뒤에 숨겨진 진짜 본색이 이제 공개됩니다.

en.title: The Flight Attendant Found Dissolved in Her Millionaire Boyfriend’s Bathtub..WHY?
en.description:
🎧 Multiple Audio Tracks Available.
Go to "Settings → Audio track" to choose your language.

In the bathroom of a luxurious mansion in Hong Kong, a dark reddish liquid mixed with chunks of flesh began to pour down from above. “It’s just my pet goldfish that died,” said the man living upstairs, Huang Dawei, with a calm smile. But what filled the house was the sharp, suffocating stench of sulfuric acid. When the tightly shut bathroom door was finally opened, inside was a bathtub filled with a highly corrosive toxic solution—and the unrecognizable remains of someone dissolved within it. A lavish and reckless man obsessed with money. A frugal flight attendant who suddenly disappeared, Wong Tze Kwan. And another woman, Yu Muling, who was willing to do anything for him. So… who was the one that vanished inside that hellish bathtub?

en.description:
🎧 Multiple Audio Tracks Available.
Go to "Settings → Audio track" to choose your language.

Da Ying (大营) and Zhang Yuanyuan (张媛媛) were a hardworking, ordinary couple until one day, they began receiving shocking messages from an anonymous account containing nude photos and explicit footage of the wife. For months, they were targeted by relentless gaslighting and threats like, "Divorce her now, she’s my woman," causing their once-happy home to crumble under the weight of suspicion and depression. Unable to endure the torment, the husband ultimately made a tragic choice to end his life. Not long after, the charred, unrecognizable body of a man was discovered in a highway drainage ditch in a remote area. Police identified the wife, Zhang Yuanyuan (张媛媛), and the husband’s close friend, Xu Guowei (徐郭伟), as the primary suspects after they were spotted near the crime scene. "I didn't kill him; that monster killed our family." Amidst the desperate cries echoing through the courtroom, what is the true identity of the "monster" who orchestrated this entire tragedy?

In Florida, USA, Joleen Cummings, a devoted mother of three and a hardworking hairstylist, vanishes without a trace on her birthday—which also happened to be Mother's Day. The police attempt to question her 20-something colleague, Jennifer Sybert, the last person to see her, but she abruptly disappears after refusing to cooperate, claiming she is hiding from a stalker.Following a relentless pursuit, authorities intercept her, only to discover something chilling inside her car: 18 different identification cards, each bearing a different name. Even more bizarre, every single name on those IDs belongs to someone who is already deceased.With unidentified bloodstains found in the back of the hair salon and eerie tools purchased just before the disappearance, the mystery deepens. What truly happened to Joleen Cummings? And what is the even more shocking secret hidden by the woman known as 'Jennifer'? We reveal the full story behind this unpredictable mystery.

en.description:

In December 2025, ordinary middle schoolers faced a horrific tragedy at a motel in Changwon. Coerced and threatened by a man they met out of curiosity in an open chat room, the girls were dragged to the motel. In a desperate attempt to save them, the boys rushed in after them, ultimately trapping all four children in a living hell: Room 307. The perpetrator, who had disguised himself as a 19-year-old peer, suddenly pulled out a hidden weapon inside the room and launched a merciless attack on the children.
The police later announced the incident as a simple impulsive crime, but lurking beneath the surface was the attacker's chilling true identity and the deeply concealed secrets of that day. What unimaginable horrors actually unfolded inside that firmly locked motel room, and what is the real truth hidden behind this gruesome tragedy?

On a remote deserted island in Guangdong, China, a mysterious suitcase washed ashore, tightly bound with iron frames and heavy chains. Inside was the body of a young woman, mutilated beyond recognition. In a desperate situation where even fingerprints had vanished, the investigation team tracked the serial number of a breast implant found inside her body, miraculously identifying her as 22-year-old model Li Qingqing (李青青).The perpetrator, Huang Feishan, claims he killed her in a fit of rage due to her verbal abuse, but as the investigation deepens, his meticulous premeditation and brutal methods bring the case to a new turning point. In a residential neighborhood in Osaka, a 17-year-old girl, Yuriko Tashiro (田代友里子), was found collapsed with her body completely broken. Her emaciated body, weighing only 40kg, was covered in countless fractures and internal bleeding—clear signs that this was no accident, but the result of someone’s deliberate and brutal “design.” As the investigation narrowed, the suspects who emerged were none other than her older sister, Eriko Tashiro (田代枝里子), and her mysterious boyfriend, Daigoro Umezaki (梅崎大五郎). snippet.title: 수억을 벌던 일본 업소녀가 '인간 말종' 조폭을 만났을 때..(생일날 벌어진 참극)
snippet.description:
00:00 (New업뎃) 요시나오 유이치 by 디바달리아
26:06 (재방편 정보) 태국에서 살해된 인플루언서 얀루이민 by 디바달리아

2020년 7월, 일본 시라하마초의 평화로운 주택가를 찢는 6살 아이의 비명. 자신의 생일날, 아이가 목격한 것은 피투성이가 된 엄마 타구치 아카네(田口朱音, Akane Taguchi)였습니다. 범인은 그녀의 헌신적인 연인이었다고 주장하는 요시나오 유이치(吉直優一, Yuichi Yoshinao), 하지만 주변인들이 말하는 사건의 실체는 전혀 달랐습니다. 한 싱글맘의 고단한 삶을 송두리째 짓밟은 그날의 참혹한 진실, 그 뒤에 숨겨진 뒤틀린 집착과 스토킹의 전말을 추적합니다.

■ 디바제시카(DEEVA JESSICA) 채널 소개 
📍 주제: 한국, 일본, 중국 등 아시아 전역과 세계 곳곳의 범죄 사건을 심층 분석하고, 압도적인 몰입감의 스토리텔링으로 전달합니다. 
📍 진행: 메인 호스트 디바제시카와 실력파 스토리텔러 디바달리아, 디바메이가 함께합니다. 
📍 시리즈 안내:
       [금요사건파일] 국내 사건사고의 재조명과 심층 분석
       [토요미스테리] 전 세계의 신비롭고 오싹한 미스테리 이야기

■ 제작진
→ 작가: ( 김가람 / 장지선/ 이기은)
→ 편집자: 쏘블링
→ BGM:김재훈 / 추악한 범죄 https://www.youtube.com/@bgmfactory_official

en.title: Multi-Millionaire Hostess Met a Sociopathic Yakuza..The Horrific Stalking of a Nightlife Queen
en.description:
00:00 (New Update) Yuichi Yoshinao by  Diva Dahlia
26:06 (Rerun Info) Influencer Yan Ruimin Murdered in Thailand by Diva Dahlia

In July 2020, the scream of a 6-year-old child tore through the peaceful residential neighborhood of Shirahama-cho, Japan. On her birthday, what the child witnessed was her bloodied mother, Akane Taguchi. The perpetrator was Yuichi Yoshinao, who claimed to be her devoted lover, but the reality of the incident as told by those around them was completely different. We track the full story of the twisted obsession and stalking hidden behind the horrific truth of that day that completely crushed the weary life of a single mother.

■ Welcome to DEEVA JESSICA: Into the Shadows of East Asia.
10 years of storytelling mastery, now uncovering the most chilling cases from South Korea, Japan, China, and beyond.
Join Deeva Jessica, Dahlia, and May as we dive deeper into criminal psychology and the hidden truths behind the headlines.
Subscribe for high-quality Asian true crime documentaries.

■ Production Team

→ Writers: ( Kim Garam / Jang Jiseon / Lee Gi-eun)
→ Editor: Ssobling
→ BGM: Kim Jaehoon / Ugly Crime https://www.youtube.com/@bgmfactory_official

📧 Business Inquiries: Jbsnetwork7@gmail.com

snippet.title: 강제 혼인에 동성애 커뮤니티 전전하던 의대생 최동욱, 여자친구를 살해한 진짜 이유
snippet.description:
00:00 (New업뎃) 강남 의대생 최동욱 여자친구 살인사건
27:49 (재방편 정보) 춘천 연인 살인사건

2018년 수능 만점자이자 연세대 의대생으로 화제를 모았던 최동욱이 서울 강남역 인근 건물 옥상에서 투신 소동을 벌이다 구조되는 사건이 발생합니다. 하지만 경찰은 옥상 구석에서 참혹하게 살해된 여성을 발견하며 사건은 새로운 국면을 맞이합니다. 피해자는 그의 중학교 시절 첫사랑으로, 성인이 되어 재회한 두 사람은 만난 지 단 2달 만에 부모 모르게 혼인신고를 할 만큼 비정상적인 관계를 이어오고 있었습니다. 완벽한 엘리트 코스를 밟아온 최동욱은 이 과정에서 지독한 소유욕과 집착을 보였고, 결국 딸을 구하려는 수지 씨 가족이 '혼인 무효 소송'을 준비하며 압박해오자 자신의 명예와 미래가 무너질까 두려워하며 돌이킬 수 없는 계획을 세우게 됩니다.

In a peaceful country house, a 72-year-old woman is found dead, her body covered in 87 brutal puncture wounds. According to neighbors, while the grandmother’s desperate screams echoed from the master bedroom, a chilling hum could be heard from somewhere in the house, as if trying to drown out the horror. The only person living with her, her 21-year-old granddaughter, sobs over the phone and promises to rush to the scene—but then, she vanishes without a trace.Why did the killer choose a low-lethality 'awl' to inflict torture-like wounds instead of using a knife to end it quickly? And just where did the granddaughter go?
